exclusionRules.not_ready_or_off_plan: Sale Application Type must be off-plan or ready (court-mandated sales excluded)
exclusionRules.unsupported_property_type: Property Type outside apartment, villa, townhouse, duplex, penthouse, villa plot, office, retail
exclusionRules.aed_per_sqft_below_p01: AED/sqft below the 1st percentile of all sales with the same district, type and bedrooms
exclusionRules.aed_per_sqft_above_p99: AED/sqft above the 99th percentile of all sales with the same district, type and bedrooms

flagMeanings.identical_row: All 14 exported fields match another row (group_key); kept as separate sales because the export has no transaction ID
flagMeanings.resale_at_earlier_primary_price: Resale with the same project, layout, area and price as an earlier primary sale (detail = that date); possibly the same home transferred at its original price, which the export cannot confirm
flagMeanings.area_far_from_layout_median: Sold area more than twice or less than half the median for this project and layout (detail = median sqm and row count); the layout or home type may be mislabelled

note: Exclusions mirror build_market_tables.py and build_project_knowledge.py; flags never exclude a row. The source export is not modified.
